notes.title: Demo Ahoy
notes.content:
Try out the demo of [i]Little Onryo[/i] today!

The demo contains the complete first world to conquer as well as your well (well, well) and training ground. Just prod that DOWNLOAD DEMO button on the store page and have at it.

Disclaimer: It's work in progress and seems pretty solid but there may of course be bugs and additions in the full game, especially music of which there isn't any in the demo, apart from on the tile page.

If you enjoy [i]Little Onryo[/i], please add it to your wishlist and good luck to you.

- Catfood
